Here's a summary of the meeting:

The team is working on the iMeeting Assistant project, focusing on the transcription module, task extraction, and summarization features. The current goal is to have a working prototype by the end of this week.

Sara has been testing the transcription pipeline using Whisper and has achieved good accuracy for short meetings with multiple speakers. However, she needs to test additional cases with speaker overlaps or fast speaking.

The team discussed the following tasks and deadlines:

- Sara will test the transcription pipeline on five more meetings and prepare a summary report by Wednesday at 4 p.m.
- Omar will implement the task extraction module and have a working prototype ready by Thursday noon for evaluation.
- Sara will prepare a labeled dataset with example transcripts and deadlines for Omar to test and improve the task extraction module.
- The team will run a full integration test on Thursday evening to check the transcription, task extraction, and database storage.
- Omar will create a simple backend API for storing meeting transcripts, detected tasks, and deadlines.
- Sara will integrate the transcription module with the backend API on Friday morning.

Additional tasks discussed include:

- Omar will create a feature to generate a short summary of the meeting highlighting key decisions, tasks, and deadlines.
- Sara will test the summarization models and prepare a comparison report before next Monday afternoon.
- Omar will review the database design to ensure it can support transcripts, extracted tasks, and summaries.
- Sara will create test queries and dashboards to visualize the information presentation to end users.
- Omar will set up automated tests to simulate end-to-end meetings and ensure module communication.

The team plans to run the first full system test by next Wednesday afternoon and gather feedback for improvements in the next version of the iMeeting Assistant.
